name: License Keys
description: Generate, deliver and activate license keys for digital products, with a machine limit per key
author: uxwVend

settingsCards.title: License Keys
settingsCards.description: Which products hand out a key, and how many.

api.description: The signed-in customer's own license keys.
Claim or release an activation seat for a machine.
Check whether a key is valid, without claiming a seat.
List every issued key, or mint new ones by hand (admin).
Revoke, restore or delete a single key (admin).
List or add the products that hand out a key (admin).
Edit or remove one product mapping (admin).
